name: com.todayinabq/abq
title: Today in ABQ
description: Live Albuquerque guide: open-now hours, nearby spots, events, 2026 openings, holidays & date plans.

tools.name: open_now
tools.description: Verified places in Albuquerque, NM open right now (local America/Denver time), computed from posted first-party hours. Filter by kind (bar, coffee, restaurant, brewery, bakery), neighborhood, or a natural keyword like patio, dogs, kids, late, live music.

kind.description: Venue type, e.g. bar, coffee, brewery, restaurant, bakery

neighborhood.description: Albuquerque neighborhood, e.g. Nob Hill, Downtown, Old Town, Sawmill, Rio Rancho

query.description: Keywords like patio, dogs, kids, late, tacos, cocktails, wifi

tools.name: nearby_open
tools.description: Find Albuquerque places open right now sorted by exact distance in miles from any neighborhood, landmark (Old Town, UNM, BioPark, Balloon Fiesta Park, Uptown, Sunport), venue name, or lat/lng coordinates.

near.description: Neighborhood, landmark, or venue name (e.g. 'Old Town', 'Nob Hill', 'UNM', 'Hotel Chaco')

lat.description: Optional latitude if exact coordinates are known

lng.description: Optional longitude if exact coordinates are known

kind.description: Optional kind filter (bar, coffee, brewery, restaurant)

query.description: Optional keyword filter (patio, tacos, late, quiet)

tools.name: events
tools.description: Dated events in Albuquerque (concerts, markets, comedy, holiday events, pop-ups) sourced from each venue's own announcement. Defaults to today through 7 days out. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

query.description: Keywords (music, comedy, market, jazz, trivia, holiday)

tools.name: weekly_nights
tools.description: Recurring weekly nights in Albuquerque: trivia, karaoke, bingo, live music, comedy, open mic. Filter by category or weekday (Monday..Sunday).

category.description: e.g. trivia, karaoke, bingo, music, comedy, open mic

day.description: Day of week, e.g. Tuesday, Fri, Sunday

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Smart search across 690+ Albuquerque restaurants, bars, breweries, coffee shops, bakeries, venues, and curated guide picks using natural keywords, neighborhoods, and amenities.

query.description: Natural search query, e.g. 'green chile stew', 'dog friendly patio', 'speakeasy', 'pho'

open_only.description: If true, return only places confirmed open right now

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full verified dossier for one Albuquerque place by slug or name: posted hours, live open status, address, phone, website, Instagram, upcoming events, weekly nights, guides it appears in, and nearby open spots.

place.description: Place name or slug (e.g. 'La Cumbre', 'sister-bar', 'Flying Star')

tools.name: guides
tools.description: Today in ABQ's curated editorial guides (pho, pizza, posole, green chile stew, bookstores, hidden bars, themed dates, new bakeries, late-night bars, drink by the fire). Call with no arguments to list all guides, or pass a topic/slug for full picks.

tools.name: seasonal_guide
tools.description: Live 2026 Albuquerque seasonal and holiday hubs: Thanksgiving dinners & deadlines, Holiday Markets by weekend, Holiday Lights (River of Lights, Twinkle Light Parade, luminarias), Christmas (tamales, Eve/Day hours, events), and New Year's Eve.

occasion.description: Slug or topic: 'christmas', 'holiday-lights', 'holiday-markets', 'thanksgiving', 'new-years-eve' (omit to list all)

query.description: Optional filter inside the seasonal hub (e.g. 'tamales', 'free', 'luminarias', 'parade')

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Albuquerque's 2026 restaurant/bar/bakery openings, closings, coming-soon city permits, and recent 'New on the Menu' seasonal dish drops — all dated and sourced.

status.description: Filter by opened, closed, closing, coming (permits), menu (new dish drops), or all

tools.name: plan_night
tools.description: Deterministically compose a verified 2-to-3 stop Albuquerque itinerary (food/coffee + drinks + nearby event or late spot) where stops are geographically close and verified open for the requested day/time.

area.description: Neighborhood or landmark (e.g. 'Nob Hill', 'Downtown', 'Old Town', 'Sawmill', 'Uptown', 'Rio Rancho')

hour.description: Start hour in 24h local time (default current hour or 18 for evening)
